geometry_policy: Preserve architecture, furniture, bevels, source object IDs and original master. No mobile simplification.
denoising: Separate official OIDN output with real Cycles albedo/normal guides; preserve raw PNG.
review_gate: Operator judges Blender first. No further PlayCanvas calibration or mobile optimization before that approval.
scope_note: Rendering profile and visual review; does not certify completion of the transferable lighting/material solution. Record unresolved shader transfers explicitly.
